UI_PS_NoServer: Soccer practice is not available yet.
UI_PS_Controls: LMB: pass/shot · RMB: high lob · hold to charge, release to kick · Esc: leave controls
UI_PS_RenderError: The soccer ball could not be displayed. Check that 3D ground items are enabled; you can end practice from the right-click menu.
UI_PS_TooManyBalls: The server has reached the practice ball limit. End an existing practice first.
UI_PS_StartFailed: Practice did not start. Keep the sports ball in your main inventory and stand on clear ground.
UI_PS_Goal: GOAL! Team %1 - restarting at the center
UI_PS_CameraUnsupported: This camera needs a soccer adapter. Viewpoint support is planned, not enabled yet.
UI_PS_Place1: Goal 1: click the start of the line. Right-click/Esc cancels.
UI_PS_Place2: Goal 1: click the end of the line (2–10 tiles).
UI_PS_Place3: Goal 2: click the start of the opposite goal line.
UI_PS_Place4: Goal 2: click the end to finish. Restart is midway between the goals.
UI_PS_GoalsInvalid: Invalid goals: clear ground, width 2-10 tiles, opposing mouths, center at least 2 tiles inside each; stand within 40 tiles of every point.
UI_PS_GoalsReady: Goals set. Choose a team from the soccer menu after leaving controls with Esc.
UI_PS_LineInvalid: Goal lines must be 2–10 tiles long. Choose the endpoint again.
UI_PS_ChargeReady: Kick power · hold a mouse button
UI_PS_ChargeRange: Full charge: 0.9s · max kick: about 24 tiles on level ground
